submission.justification: Absorber-F3 with 6 mm plates achieves the best possible energy resolution (3.884% at 100 GeV) among the materials that satisfy the hands-on maintenance constraint. While Absorber-F2 would provide better resolution (~3.1%), it produces a residual dose rate of 85 μSv/h, which exceeds the 20 μSv/h limit required for hands-on maintenance during shutdowns. Absorber-F3 meets this critical safety requirement with 12 μSv/h while still providing excellent energy resolution. Absorber-F1, though it has the lowest activation (6 μSv/h), delivers significantly worse resolution (best: 4.881% at 7 mm). The simulation scan over plate thicknesses from 2-8 mm shows that 6 mm is optimal for Absorber-F3, balancing sampling fraction and shower containment.
